# `touchcue`

- **Usage:** `touchcue [--config <PATH>] [-v --verbose] <SUBCOMMAND>`

## Global Flags
- **`--config <PATH>`** — Configuration file [default: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/touchcue/config.toml]
- **`-v --verbose`** — Log more: -v for info, -vv for debug; TOUCHCUE_LOG overrides it

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
- **`-V --version`** — Print version
